# dim_canonical_rooms

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.dim_canonical_rooms` · dbt area: `portal`

Dimension table of canonical rooms per supplier, with their attributes and resolved room type. Each row represents a single canonical room. Archived rooms are excluded.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `canonical_room_id` | Primary Key. Unique identifier for the canonical room. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `area_sqft_max` | Maximum room area in square feet. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `area_sqft_min` | Minimum room area in square feet. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `bathroom_count` | Number of bathrooms in the room. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `bedroom_count` | Number of bedrooms in the room. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `created_at` | Timestamp when the canonical room was created. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `data_source` | Source the canonical room record was created from. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `hotel_website_url` | URL of the room on the hotel website. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_hidden` | True/false flag indicating whether the room is hidden. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_needs_review` | True/false flag indicating whether the room mapping needs review. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `max_adults` | Maximum number of adults the room accommodates. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `max_children` | Maximum number of children the room accommodates. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `max_occupancy` | Maximum total occupancy of the room. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `room_description` | Description of the canonical room. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `room_name` | Name of the canonical room. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `room_type` | Room type label resolved from the room type attribute (e.g. Suite, Standard). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `room_type_attribute_id` | Foreign Key to the room attribute that defines the room type. Resolves to room_type. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `supplier_id` | Foreign Key. Unique identifier for the supplier (hotel) the room belongs to. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp when the canonical room was last updated. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `year_last_renovated` | Year the room was last renovated. >> SOURCE - Portal |
